# Curry and Grill

> Curry and Grill in Vandalia, OH offers fine Indian and Himalayan cuisine, featuring traditional curries, biryanis, and grilled specialties.

## Menu
Curry and Grill in Vandalia, OH is known for its flavorful Indian and Himalayan cuisine, offering a variety of traditional curries, biryanis, and grilled specialties. Diners frequently enjoy favorites like chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, and momos.

### Offers
- Lunch Buffet
